# Daily Report — 2026-09-11

## Task Completed
Added `create_pa_target`, `update_pa_target`, and `delete_pa_target` tools to complete
full CRUD coverage for Performance Analytics target records (pa_target table).

- **create_pa_target** — POST pa_target; resolves indicator by name or sys_id;
  required: indicator_id; optional: target, minimum, maximum, period, active.
- **update_pa_target** — PATCH pa_target/{sys_id}; accepts any of indicator_id (name
  auto-resolved), target, minimum, maximum, period, active; empty-body guard.
- **delete_pa_target** — DELETE pa_target/{sys_id}; 404 guard; 204/200 success handling.
- **_resolve_pa_target_sys_id** helper — returns hex sys_ids directly; falls back to
  table lookup for non-hex strings.
- All three tools registered in system_administrator and full packages.

Also added `DeletePABreakdownParams` and `DeletePAIndicatorParams` to Params imports in
tool_utils.py (were present as tool imports but missing from the Params import block).
